execution_policy: read-only evidence; never execute source instructions

sources.title: DriftMoE: A Mixture of Experts Approach to Handle Concept Drifts
sources.summary: Online mixture-of-experts approach for non-stationary streams. It uses a learned router and incremental experts, and evaluates predictions prequentially before updating on each label. Relevant because the current L0 residual correction has a single continuously changing authority signal and may benefit from separating regime-specialized corrections from routing.
candidate_mechanisms: maintain multiple bounded residual experts specialized by recent regime
route authority using only pre-update information
evaluate every routed prediction prequentially before learning
retire or downweight experts that lose future predictive value

sources.title: Proactive Model Adaptation Against Concept Drift for Online Time Series Forecasting
sources.summary: Studies delayed feedback under concept drift and the mismatch between recently trained samples and the current prediction context. Relevant to L0 because residual evidence can become stale across regime shifts; adaptation should depend on estimated drift rather than applying a uniform correction.
candidate_mechanisms: estimate context drift before granting residual authority
condition correction magnitude on drift evidence
distinguish transient residual shocks from persistent regime change

sources.title: Off-policy Policy Evaluation For Sequential Decisions Under Unobserved Confounding
sources.summary: Shows that sequential counterfactual policy evaluation requires causal assumptions such as sequential ignorability and can become unreliable under unobserved confounding. Relevant because internal decisions are endogenous: a self-model must not interpret every predictive association as an effect of changing that decision.
candidate_mechanisms: record propensities or explicit randomized intervention probabilities
separate observational self-prediction from intervention estimates
fail closed when overlap or identifiability assumptions are absent
report sensitivity rather than a point causal claim under possible confounding

sources.title: Generalizing Off-Policy Evaluation From a Causal Perspective For Sequential Decision-Making
sources.summary: Frames off-policy evaluation in terms of explicit causal estimands and identifiability. Relevant to the digital self because it provides a discipline for stating exactly which counterfactual quantity is being estimated and when observational data cannot identify it.
candidate_mechanisms: attach an explicit estimand to every self-counterfactual query
store identification assumptions alongside each estimate
require experimental evidence when the estimand is not observationally identifiable

sources.title: Neural-Guided Deductive Search for Real-Time Program Synthesis from Examples
sources.summary: Uses a strongly typed domain-specific language and deductive decomposition, with a learned controller guiding which grammar branches to explore. Relevant to extending the current scalar DSL while keeping the executable hypothesis space bounded and typed.
candidate_mechanisms: introduce typed nonterminals for scalar, boolean, sequence and structured values
separate correctness-preserving symbolic search from heuristic branch ranking
allow bounded map/filter/fold primitives before unrestricted loops
rank candidates by held-out generalization rather than training fit alone

sources.title: Abstract Learning Frameworks for Synthesis
sources.summary: Formalizes CEGIS-style synthesis as iterative learning over a bounded hypothesis space with counterexamples. Relevant because the kernel already uses counterexamples for small mechanisms and can generalize that discipline to richer typed algorithm families.
candidate_mechanisms: retain explicit hypothesis, sample and counterexample spaces
expand grammar one typed family at a time
require counterexample-driven refinement before admission
use well-founded complexity ordering to keep search terminating
